Record explorer

70 records from the validation and the two test sets (10 per class). They include the records shown in the M4 disagreement figure and up to 20 records where the rules and the GBM disagree (test_shift has 224 such records in total, test_iid 3). Stored results come from the Python reference; the button re-runs the C core in your browser on the stored waveform. The test records are shown after the one-shot sealed evaluation; nothing here was used to choose a method.
